title: General.
officialText:
Wastewater recycling systems installed in accordance with section C102 of appendix C of the New
York city plumbing code shall be periodically inspected and tested in accordance with this article. This article shall not apply
to rainwater recycling systems installed in accordance with section C103 of appendix C of the New York city plumbing
code.
